question: If AI no longer needs special tricks to understand us, what skills do we need to work well with it?
reflection: Explaining clearly what we want and why is a human skill that improves our work with machines and with each other.

sources.subject: Prompt engineering is dead. Here's what works now
Claude Mobile Update, OpenAI API Credits, DeepSeek 1M Tokens

one_line: Getting good results from AI is shifting from clever prompt formulas to clear goals, context and judgement, while competition over who controls models and platforms intensifies.

top_stories.title: Prompt tricks fade, clear briefing matters more
top_stories.what: Forward Future's team says old techniques such as assigning the AI an expert role now add little, and the real skill is explaining what you want, why it matters and what a good result looks like.
top_stories.why: This turns AI training for staff into a communication and judgement skill, which fits behavioural and learning design better than technical prompt courses.

top_stories.title: Chinese labs reportedly train on OpenAI model outputs
top_stories.what: DeepSeek and Moonshot AI are reportedly using answers from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to train their own models, a practice called distillation, after Anthropic tightened its defences against it.
top_stories.why: Copying model behaviour through outputs is becoming a front in the US-China AI race and may lead to tighter access rules for API users abroad.

top_stories.title: US examines NVIDIA's plan to buy Hugging Face
top_stories.what: The US Justice Department is reviewing NVIDIA's planned $12.93 billion purchase of Hugging Face, the main platform for sharing open models and datasets, and its wider sales practices.
top_stories.why: Many research teams rely on Hugging Face for open models, so a change in ownership could affect access and neutrality.

saudi_lens.text: Saudi digital-skills programmes could shift AI training from prompt formulas towards problem framing, context giving and checking results.
Saudi teams that rely on open models from Hugging Face should keep local copies of key models in case access terms change.

idea.title: Briefing skills for AI at work
idea.pitch: A short workshop and pre-post test that teaches staff to state goal, context and quality criteria when using AI, then measures output quality.
idea.first_step: Write a one-page template with three prompts: what I want, why it matters, what good looks like.
